description: The shared settings every Xena repo extends (pinned third-party actions, the Monday schedule, Node majors by approval) are in xena-studios/.github's renovate-config.json. These rules are this repo's own.

packageRules.description: The site (site/) runs astro check, which doesn't support TypeScript 7 yet. The build at the root already uses 7. Drop this once @astrojs/check supports it.
The site's undici override (site/pnpm-workspace.yaml) patches Miniflare's undici 7, which it pins: keep it on 7, and remove it once Wrangler ships a patched 7.
